meta.description: An AI tool for indie developers that turns a README or GitHub repository into X marketing posts, article drafts, and App Store screenshots.

footer.disclaimer: Code Tweet generates AI drafts. Please review the content before posting.

legal.fallbackNotice: This document is only available in Japanese and English. Showing the English version.

notePage.title: Create a note Draft from your README
notePage.description: Generate an article draft you can copy and paste into note.com, from a GitHub repository or project description.

homePage.title: Turn a README into posts and article drafts
homePage.description: Generate X posts and note.com article drafts from a GitHub repository or project description, all on one page.

generateForm.guestNote: You get 3 generations without signing in, and 3 per month with GitHub sign-in. Posts and note Drafts share the same count.
generateForm.memberNote: Posts and note Drafts share your monthly generation count (README limit: {limit} characters).
generateForm.heroLead: Just paste a GitHub repository URL and
generateForm.heroTweet: get 5 posts — a week's worth — from your README.
generateForm.heroNote: get one Markdown draft ready to paste into note.com.
generateForm.heroAppss: let AI write the headlines for your App Store screenshots.
generateForm.errorReadmeTooLong: The README is too long. Your current plan allows up to {limit} characters.
generateForm.errorRepoUrlRequired: Please enter a GitHub repository URL.
generateForm.quickNote: Create a note Draft from README
generateForm.loadingNote: AI is writing your note Draft
generateForm.loadingAppss: AI is coming up with your screenshot headlines
generateForm.appssFormTitle: Create screenshot headlines from your README
generateForm.appssFormDesc: Pick a repository from GitHub or enter a URL. Private repositories are available to credit pack purchasers.
generateForm.appNameHint: Detected automatically from your README. Edit it here if it's wrong.
generateForm.appssProjectTextPlaceholder: Filled in automatically when you load a README. Trimming it down to what matters makes the copy sharper.
generateForm.projectTextHint: A full README, release notes, or a feature list all work.
generateForm.appssTonePlaceholder: e.g. Warm and friendly tone, aimed at women in their 20s–30s.
generateForm.appssToneHint: Describe the mood and audience for the headlines in plain words (up to 200 characters).
generateForm.themeHint: With "Let AI choose", the theme is picked from your app's content (you can change it in the editor).
generateForm.appssGenerateHint: AI reads your README and writes the headlines for your App Store screenshots. Screenshots you upload are placed for you from the start, and you can swap or add more in the editor (uses one generation).
generateForm.openGithub: Open GitHub and copy a repository URL

generateInputs.advancedDesc: Adjust the tone, the URL to include, hashtags, and the description.
generateInputs.loadReadmeHelp: Pick a repository from GitHub, or enter a URL at the bottom of the dialog to load a README.
generateInputs.publicRepoNote: Public repositories work with just a URL. Private repositories are available to credit pack purchasers.
generateInputs.projectTextPlaceholder: e.g. A task manager for indie developers. It syncs with GitHub Issues and visualizes your daily progress.
generateInputs.toneMemoPlaceholder: e.g. Aimed at indie developers, slightly casual, go easy on the emoji
generateInputs.toneMemoHint: Briefly specify the tone you want, or wording to avoid.
generateInputs.urlNotFound: No matching URL found in the README
generateInputs.urlHint: Pick a URL detected in your README with these buttons. A lead-in line matching its type is added automatically.
generateInputs.hashtagsHint: Related tags are added on top of the ones you enter (X posts get up to 3 in total).
generateInputs.reviewNotice: Always review the output before posting. Please verify facts such as URLs, prices, and feature names yourself.
